- **Scope:** Positive map-worker counts create joinable bounded Rust threads sharing an Arc dataset, route batch sequence s to worker s modulo worker count, initialize and construct one transform per worker, fetch and transform in worker scope, collate on the coordinator, preserve sampler order by default, optionally yield completion order, convert worker panics, and terminate after one typed failure.

- **Evidence:** [`crates/rusttorch-data/tests/map_workers.rs::positive_workers_fetch_batches_concurrently_on_distinct_threads`](../crates/rusttorch-data/tests/map_workers.rs), [`crates/rusttorch-data/tests/map_workers.rs::ordered_and_completion_modes_follow_the_selected_contract`](../crates/rusttorch-data/tests/map_workers.rs), [`crates/rusttorch-data/tests/map_workers.rs::batch_sequence_routes_to_its_modulo_worker_across_iterations`](../crates/rusttorch-data/tests/map_workers.rs), [`crates/rusttorch-data/tests/map_workers.rs::factory_and_initializer_run_once_per_worker_with_fresh_generations`](../crates/rusttorch-data/tests/map_workers.rs), [`crates/rusttorch-data/tests/map_workers.rs::worker_and_coordinator_errors_are_typed_visible_once_and_contextual`](../crates/rusttorch-data/tests/map_workers.rs), [`crates/rusttorch-data/tests/map_workers.rs::worker_panics_are_converted_with_worker_and_batch_context`](../crates/rusttorch-data/tests/map_workers.rs), [`crates/rusttorch-data/tests/map_workers.rs::early_drop_disconnects_saturated_work_and_joins_every_worker`](../crates/rusttorch-data/tests/map_workers.rs), [`crates/rusttorch-data/tests/worker_context.rs::worker_info_scopes_are_nested_and_panic_safe`](../crates/rusttorch-data/tests/worker_context.rs), [`crates/rusttorch-data/tests/worker_context.rs::worker_info_is_isolated_between_concurrent_threads`](../crates/rusttorch-data/tests/worker_context.rs), [`crates/rusttorch-data/tests/worker_context.rs::worker_info_validates_identity_and_locks_versioned_seed_derivation`](../crates/rusttorch-data/tests/worker_context.rs), [`crates/rusttorch-data/tests/worker_context.rs::worker_seed_derivation_does_not_change_libtorch_global_rng`](../crates/rusttorch-data/tests/worker_context.rs), [`tests/data.rs::facade_reexports_task_transform_and_worker_context_contracts`](../tests/data.rs)
- **Notes:** Rust threads replace Python subprocesses: map datasets are shared rather than copied, collation stays on the coordinator, and WorkerInfo intentionally omits an erased dataset. Worker and task seeds are versioned local derivations with no PyTorch generator or Philox identity. Timeout and persistence reject before sampler, factory, initializer, or thread side effects until Task 8; pinning remains stored but unapplied until Task 10.

## Python-only

### `compiler.compile`

- **PyTorch:** `torch.compile`
- **RustTorch:** —
- **Implementation:** Not implemented
- **Scope:** CPython frame capture, Dynamo guards, and Python graph-break semantics are not native RustTorch APIs.
- **Pinned source:** [`torch/_dynamo/eval_frame.py`](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/cf30153/torch/_dynamo/eval_frame.py)
- **Evidence:** —
- **Notes:** Rust deployment may consume compatible artifacts later without claiming Python runtime parity.

### `compiler.export`

- **PyTorch:** `torch.export.export`
- **RustTorch:** —
- **Implementation:** Not implemented
- **Scope:** Python program capture, dynamic Python object handling, and Python-side export diagnostics are not native RustTorch APIs.
- **Pinned source:** [`torch/export/__init__.py`](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/cf30153/torch/export/__init__.py)
- **Evidence:** —
- **Notes:** Capture is tracked separately from planned PT2 artifact interoperability.

### `compiler.fx`

- **PyTorch:** `torch.fx.Graph`, `torch.fx.GraphModule`, `torch.fx.symbolic_trace`
- **RustTorch:** —
- **Implementation:** Not implemented
- **Scope:** Python symbolic tracing, dynamic module reconstruction, and FX graph compatibility are not provided.
- **Pinned source:** [`torch/fx/graph.py`](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/cf30153/torch/fx/graph.py)
- **Evidence:** —
- **Notes:** RustTorch's typed graph has separate rows and is not described as FX-compatible.

## Not supported

### `serialization.pickle`

- **PyTorch:** `torch.save`, `torch.load`
- **RustTorch:** —
- **Implementation:** Not implemented
- **Scope:** Arbitrary Python pickle objects, whole-model class reconstruction, and CPython object graphs are intentionally unavailable.
- **Pinned source:** [`torch/serialization.py`](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/cf30153/torch/serialization.py)
- **Evidence:** —
- **Notes:** RustTorch uses typed model construction and SafeTensors instead of executing pickle payloads.

### `serialization.torchscript`

- **PyTorch:** `torch.jit.load`, `torch.jit.ScriptModule`
- **RustTorch:** —
- **Implementation:** Not implemented
- **Scope:** RustTorch does not expose TorchScript modules or convert TorchScript into eager modules or its graph IR.
- **Pinned source:** [`torch/jit/__init__.py`](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/cf30153/torch/jit/__init__.py)
- **Evidence:** —
- **Notes:** Applications may use tch::CModule directly outside the RustTorch contract.
